calls=[]; delays=[]

from retry import request
responses=iter([{'status':429,'headers':{'Retry-After':'3'}},{'status':503},{'status':200}]); delays=[]
assert request('GET',lambda: next(responses),delays.append,3)['status']==200 and delays==[3.0,2]
